_guidance.default: Review every value in the form; Quick-fill never submits.
_guidance.greenhouse: Recheck searchable dropdowns after pasting; they can replace their own field controls.
_guidance.lever: Leave checkboxes, radio buttons, and CAPTCHA controls for manual review.
_guidance.ashby: Confirm the success page before marking applied; a filled form is not a submission.
_guidance.workday: Tab out after pasting and confirm the field's validation has cleared.
